medium.note: The lived rhythm. Damped about 0.83, so roughly 3.1 K peak-to-peak, some thirty times Earth's solar-cycle signal and the dominant climatic fact of any individual life. Fast enough to be planned around, too fast for ice to follow.

long.note: The geomorphic driver. Essentially undamped at 0.99, roughly 5.2 K peak-to-peak, slow enough that glaciers equilibrate rather than merely breathing. Each grand minimum is a distinct historical era.

executable.note: Built precision is not encoded in the filename. If model.precision_bytes changes, pass recompile=True or remove the binary, or the old one is silently reused.

surface_fields.note: Fields absent from the run directory are preset to uniform namelist values by landmod and never read from file.

energy_fixer_applied.note: the energy the fixer had to restore; a CORRECTION and not physics. It is the size of the defect on world-0ov, which the fixer otherwise hides. Second half of the run only.
